sources.title: Sauerbraten engine/server.cpp (standalone server main loop) - source mirror
Sauerbraten fpsgame/client.cpp (client console commands: kick, clearbans, setmaster) - source mirror

notes: The Sauerbraten dedicated server has no command channel a server manager can drive: no RCON, no HTTP/REST admin API, and no stdin console. In the server source, the STANDALONE main() only parses argv and calls initserver(true, true), and rundedicatedserver() is `for(;;) serverslice(true, 5);` (plus a Windows PeekMessage pump) with no fgets/getline/select-on-stdin/ReadConsole anywhere. Administration happens over the game protocol from a connected game CLIENT: an admin types /setmaster <adminpass> (the -p adminpass startup option) and then /kick <cn|name> [reason], /spectator, /mastermode, /clearbans in the CLIENT console - registered in src/fpsgame/client.cpp as COMMAND(kick,"ss"), COMMAND(clearbans,""), COMMAND(setmaster,"ss"), ICOMMAND(mastermode,"i"), ICOMMAND(spectator,"is"). They are client commands, not text a manager can send to the server process. Do not record them as commands: the ban-clearing command is `clearbans` (NOT clearallbans); the server-side CubeScript names are different again (ipban, clearipbans, adduser, clearusers, maprotation in src/fpsgame/server.cpp), and those only run from server-init.cfg, which is executed once at startup with no reload. The server does answer the read-only extinfo UDP query on serverport+1 (server info and connected-player stats), which could feed a roster but carries no commands. Note that /kick also IP-bans for 4 hours or until the server empties, and players are addressed by client number (cn) or name, not by a persistent account id. Third-party server mods - hopmod, zeromod, remod, QServ - add their own remote/IRC/stdin admin channels; those are separate builds and are not described here. The manpage's phrase for -p, "password to remote administrate the server", refers to this in-client master/admin flow, not to a remote console. Sources agree; none claims an official server-side console.
